en-US.description: Shortcut-driven translation for anything you see, write or say, in any app.
en-US.longDescription: Trancy Air is a desktop translation tool driven by shortcuts. Select a sentence or word to get an instant translation with phonetics, definitions and examples, type in your own language and replace it in place with the target language, or hold a shortcut and speak to turn speech into translated text. It also offers screenshot translation, comparison of several AI translation engines, sentence splitting and grammar analysis, a save-for-later word card flow with pronunciation scoring, and sync to the Trancy Learning Center.
en-US.name: Trancy Air

zh-CN.description: Trancy Air 是一款快捷键驱动的翻译工具，可在任意应用中翻译你看到的、输入的与说出的内容。
zh-CN.longDescription: Trancy Air 是一款以快捷键为核心的桌面翻译工具。选中句子或单词即可获得即时翻译，附发音、释义与例句；用自己的语言输入，一键原位替换为目标语言；按住快捷键说话，即可将语音转为译文。它还提供截图翻译、多 AI 引擎对比翻译、句子切分与语法分析、词卡收藏与口语跟读评分，并可与 Trancy Learning Center 同步。
